answers.quote: A diff that both restructures code and changes behaviour, so you can't tell which lines do which, is a finding: reopen with "split the refactor out"
answers.why: The reader's rules have nothing on keeping a refactor apart from a behaviour change; it is general, though phrased as a review finding. Its test-fails-without-the-change check is already examples/reader/rules/engineering.md rule 3.

answers.quote: You may try the same action, on your own judgement, and report the result, allowed or refused, as a data point.
answers.why: Reviewer may retry an action the worker's classifier refused with no limit to non-destructive actions; examples/reader/rules/safety.md rule 1 says never run anything destructive without the owner's explicit go-ahead in this conversation, and the refused action may be exactly that.
